title: 'My husband tried to kill me but what I saw on other side changed everything'
excerpt: Ana Christina claims she saw her late mother, father and sister as radiant bodies of light during a near-death experience after her husband allegedly poisoned her dinner with rat poison
content:
Ana Christina claims she saw her late mother, father and sister as radiant bodies of light during a near-death experience after her husband allegedly poisoned her dinner with rat poison

15:42, 13 Oct 2026

A woman says she was reunited with her dead mother, father and sister during a near-death experience after her husband allegedly poisoned her dinner. Ana Christina said her loved ones appeared as radiant bodies of light rather than in their human forms. She described the reunion as a source of comfort that left her no longer afraid of death.

‌

‌

Speaking on the NDE (near-death experience) Journey YouTube channel, Ana recalled seeing her mother, who had died a year before the alleged poisoning, her father, who died in a car accident, and her sister Nadia, who died by suicide aged 35.

‌

She said: "I came to another entrance and saw a body of light. And that body of light was my mother. She was standing there waiting to greet me," reports the Mirror.

‌

"And she didn't have any facial features, she was just a body of light. But my soul recognised who she was straight away. I went to her, she had died a year before my incident."

Ana said she saw her sister Nadia next. She continued: "And I've always wondered where she (Nadia) was. Nadia had a beautiful heart but was in a deep depression where she just took her life. We have a father in heaven, who is so compassionate and doesn't judge us like we judge each other.

"I dashed out to the hallway where my mother was, and she was standing with another body of light, which was my father.

"My father had been killed in a car accident when I was 22 years old and I never really got over it. Seeing him there was really a beautiful closure for me. The overwhelming joy of seeing them in such a beautiful setting."

Ana claims the experience happened after her husband attempted to kill her by putting rat poison in her dinner. She said she became temporarily paralysed and feared her life was coming to an end before eventually regaining consciousness.

‌

The mum said what she believed she had experienced in the afterlife changed her outlook. While life has its "ups and downs", she described the other side as a place of "peace, joy and love".

She said seeing her loved ones brought immense comfort and strengthened her belief that people are reunited with those they care about after death.

Ana stated: "I didn't feel: 'Oh, I'm dead now.' There was no end. No beginning. There was no darkness then light. I just kept on going. It was a wonderful feeling.

‌

"Some people ask me what is the most significant part of my encounter and I tell them when he told that he's in every little detail of my life, knowing that, realising that and coming back to live life with that knowledge has been an amazing blessing.

"And that's him, the spirit of God. Think of him as a guardian angel. We are not alone and we don't die alone either."

‌

After regaining consciousness, Ana said she was baffled about what had happened. She feared she might have suffered a heart attack or stroke, but her ECG and brain scan were normal.

She said her solicitor then recommended a forensic hair analysis. Laboratory results reportedly indicated high levels of lead, mercury and selenium in her system.

Ana stated: "All these chemicals are usually found in rat poisoning. And we believe he put the rat poisoning into my rice, into the dinner, into the rice that night to finish me off so that I don't go to Egypt because he was running out of time."
